hints.id: Permanent identifier for this category. Used in the admin and APIs; it cannot be changed after creation.
hints.title: Public name shown in the storefront navigation and category pages.

titleLocale.pl: Category name shown in the storefront (Polish). Required.
titleLocale.en: Category name shown in the storefront (English). Required.

hints.slug: URL path segment for this category. Filled from the title until you edit it manually. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
hints.subtitle: Optional supporting line displayed under the category title.

subtitleLocale.pl: Optional supporting line under the category title (Polish).
subtitleLocale.en: Optional supporting line under the category title (English).

hints.shortDescription: Brief summary used in cards, listings, and previews.

shortDescriptionLocale.pl: Brief summary for cards and listings (Polish).
shortDescriptionLocale.en: Brief summary for cards and listings (English).

hints.description: Full description shown on the category page.

descriptionLocale.pl: Full description on the category page (Polish).
descriptionLocale.en: Full description on the category page (English).

hints.parentCategory: Optional parent for nested categories. Leave empty for a top-level category.
hints.status: Draft categories are hidden from the storefront; active categories are visible to customers.
hints.image: Hero or thumbnail image for this category in the storefront and admin.

validation.LOCALE_TITLE_REQUIRED: Fill in this field for the selected language.
validation.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only
validation.submitBlockedDescription: Check highlighted fields and try again.

toast.createSuccessDescription: Your category has been created successfully.
toast.errorDescription: The category could not be saved. Please try again.
toast.duplicateHandle: A category with this URL slug already exists.
toast.reorderErrorDescription: The new category order could not be saved. Please try again.
toast.deleteErrorDescription: The selected categories could not be deleted. Please try again.
toast.deleteHasChildrenDescription: Remove or reassign child categories before deleting a parent category.
toast.deleteHasProductsDescription: Reassign or remove products from these categories before deleting them.
toast.invalidParent: Choose a valid parent category that is not this category or one of its descendants.
